name: progressive-ux-design
description: Layered UX flow design: high-level flows, low-level state-machine flows, and user personas, plus conversion of existing UX docs into those templates. Also includes a style switcher that previews pages in the look of other sites, and design-refine, a bounded critique-and-fix loop that improves a styled page. A critique-aesthetics mode judges how a built page looks against a typography, colour, spacing and button rulebook, then offers to fix.
